title: Copyrighting his own tunes with Paul Barbarin
summary: He copyrighted tunes with Paul Barbarin by mailing them to Washington, but does not know what became of them.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: When I first started playing -- I didn't

even know what to do with them after I wrote them. I used to copyright my own tunes. I don't know what I did with the copyrights. And Paul Barbarin and I -- he used to stay at my house when he got off some show. And we had a little house back of our house that he and his wife lived in, and him and I, we'd sit in the back there and we'd dig up little ideas and I'd write them down and we sent to Washington to the copyright people and copyright them and put a name on. I don't know whatever happened to them.
There should be a record in Washington, shouldn't there?
I guess so, but that's been years ago. Those could be public domain, you know, after 28 years, is it? There were a lot of things.
What years do you suppose you started copyrighting tunes? Maybe this could be looked up.
